gate.title: We have updated our privacy rules
gate.body: We have rewritten the Privacy Notice, the Terms of Service and the Data Processing Agreement for your clients' data. What is new: clear rules on what happens to data when an account is closed, the public list of providers, separate consents recorded one by one. To keep using the professional area, please review and accept the updated documents.
gate.error: Your choice could not be saved. Please try again shortly.
gate.declinedTitle: Without accepting you cannot use Stress Index
gate.declinedBody: You can go back and accept, or close the account from the app settings. To export your clients' data or for any question write to {privacyEmail}.
